title: Super League Stockholders Approve Metaplanet’s 2,100 BTC Investment, Paving Way for ‘Superplanet’
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Super League Stockholders Approve Metaplanet’s 2,100 BTC Investment, Paving Way for ‘Superplanet’
Japanese bitcoin giant Metaplanet is acquiring around 96% of Nasdaq-listed Super League.
This post Super League Stockholders Approve Metaplanet’s 2,100 BTC Investment, Paving Way for ‘...
content:
Super League stockholders have approved all proposals tied to Metaplanet‘s 2,100 BTC investment, clearing the way for the Nasdaq-listed company to be renamed Superplanet and become the Japanese firm’s U.S. Bitcoin treasury vehicle.

The proposals passed at Super League Enterprise, Inc.’s 2026 annual meeting of stockholders, held Friday and were disclosed Monday morning. The transaction itself was first announced in August.

Under the definitive agreement, Metaplanet, Inc. will contribute 2,100 Bitcoin and $2.5 million in cash through its wholly owned U.S. subsidiary, Metaplanet Holdings, Inc. 

In exchange, Metaplanet receives 44,859,400 shares of common stock at $3.00 per share, along with preferred stock and warrants.

At closing, Super League will be renamed “Superplanet, Inc.” and trade on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol “SUPA.” Its advertising and media activation business will continue as a distinct operating segment, and Matt Edelman will remain chief executive officer.

Among the measures stockholders approved were the issuance of common stock and warrants to Metaplanet and the corporate name change. The proposals also included an increase in authorized preferred shares from 10 million to 100 million, according to a summary of the meeting posted on X.

“Super League stockholders have voted to approve the proposed Metaplanet transaction, an important step in our transformation from a Bitcoin treasury company into a global Bitcoin-native financial platform,” Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich wrote on X. 

“Upon close, Superplanet will be our U.S.-listed Bitcoin treasury platform, providing direct access to U.S. capital markets and greater flexibility to opportunistically raise capital.”

Edelman framed the vote similarly in the company’s announcement: “Their approval brings us one step closer to redefining what this company can become.”

Closing is anticipated in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, including required filings with the Nasdaq Capital Market. The shareholder approvals represent a required step but not the final one.

Super League said the arrangement is intended to establish conditions governing Metaplanet’s ability to dispose of its equity holdings following the transaction. The company did not provide details of exceptions to those restrictions in its announcement.

Metaplanet held 43,000 BTC as of August 18, describing itself as the third-largest corporate Bitcoin treasury among publicly traded companies. The combined structure is intended to give the group two listed Bitcoin treasury platforms — one on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, one on Nasdaq — each with its own investor base and reporting currency.

Super League connects brands with what it describes as a 3.3 billion-person global gaming population through advertising and branded content programs across gaming and digital media platforms. Metaplanet is a Tokyo-listed company building Bitcoin-based financial products and infrastructure.

Shares of Super League moved higher on the news. 

Mathew Di Salvo

Mathew is a reporter who's covered the space since 2019, reporting on everything from Salvadoran president Nayib Bukele's Bitcoin bet to crypto exchange FTX's bankruptcy.

title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
summary: Mesh will connect crypto and stablecoin wallets to Visa’s global payment network, allowing users to spend digital assets without a separate card.
content:
Visa and crypto payments network Mesh have partnered to allow consumers to spend cryptocurrency and stablecoin balances directly from digital wallets at merchants across Visa’s global payment network.

The integration will allow users of participating wallets to pay in stores or online without transferring funds to a bank account or obtaining a separate crypto card, according to a Monday announcement from Mesh. Merchants will receive payments through Visa’s existing network without changing their checkout systems.

Visa’s network covers more than 175 million merchant locations across over 200 countries and territories. Mesh said participating wallets, supported devices and launch dates will be announced as rollout plans are finalized.

Mesh will handle transaction funding and conversion between cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and fiat currencies, with Visa payment credentials provisioned through participating wallet apps. The company will also manage customer onboarding and Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements.

The partnership follows Mesh’s integration with Bybit Pay in September, allowing users to spend directly from their exchange balances on supported platforms. In January, Mesh raised $75 million in a Dragonfly-led funding round that valued the company at $1 billion.

title: Google Broadens UAE Crypto Ad Eligibility, Clarifies CFD and Forex Rules
summary:
From 21 October, Google will apply updated licensing requirements to ads for crypto exchanges, software wallets, CFDs and rolling spot forex targeting users in the United Arab Emirates. 
Firms in all four categories need a licence for the service they promote and separate Google certification before...
content:
2026-10-19T21:15:16.928+02:00

Monday, 19/10/2026 | 19:15 GMT by Tanya Chepkova

  • Crypto exchanges and software-wallet providers targeting UAE users can seek Google ad certification with an eligible CMA, DFSA, FSRA or VARA licence.
  • For CFD and rolling spot forex brokers, the licensing routes are essentially unchanged: SCA’s name is replaced with that of its successor, the CMA.

From 21 October, Google will apply updated licensing requirements to ads for crypto exchanges, software wallets, CFDs and rolling spot forex targeting users in the United Arab Emirates.

Firms in all four categories need a licence for the service they promote and separate Google certification before their ads can run.

Who Can Advertise Crypto to UAE Clients?

A crypto exchange or software-wallet provider can seek approval with an appropriate licence from one of the four regulators: the Capital Market Authority (CMA), Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) or Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA).

For CFD and rolling spot forex advertising, Google recognises licences from the CMA, DFSA and FSRA.

In either category, the advertiser must also comply with local law and complete Google’s certification process through its Google Ads account.

These are rules for ads targeting the UAE, not just for companies based there. A multi-asset brokerage group therefore needs to check which of its legal entities provides each advertised service.

A licence held by one entity, or approval to advertise CFDs, does not automatically cover a crypto campaign run under the same brand.

What Changes on 21 October?

Licensed crypto exchanges and software-wallet providers have been able to advertise to UAE users since February 2025. Google’s currently published policy specifies a VARA licence or an FSRA licence to operate a multilateral trading facility.

The October update lists the CMA and DFSA as well, and no longer limits the FSRA route to multilateral trading facilities.

The change for CFD and rolling spot forex brokers is narrower. Google’s existing policy already accepts licences from the SCA, DFSA and FSRA. The new wording substitutes the CMA for the SCA, which it replaced as legal successor in January 2026.

For a broker offering both leveraged trading and crypto services, the practical distinction is that each campaign must qualify under the rules for its own product.

October’s wider set of licensing routes could change the position for crypto ads; the CFD update primarily brings Google’s regulator name up to date.

title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
summary: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.
content:
Mastercard is extending its payment risk controls to stablecoin transactions by introducing a tool that lets financial institutions flag suspicious activity before funds move onchain, where recovering stolen funds can be difficult.

Unveiled Monday at the Money20/20 USA conference, Mastercard’s Stablecoin Security combines traditional payment data with blockchain analytics to identify fraud, scams, sanctions exposure and other financial crime risks. Borderless.xyz and Keyrails are the initial partners, with global commercial availability expected next year.

Banks already use fraud detection to monitor conventional payments. Stablecoins add complexity because funds can move across multiple wallets and blockchains, making it harder to assess risk throughout a transaction. Mastercard said Stablecoin Security can generate a risk score before a payment is completed, allowing banks to identify transactions that may require further review.

The launch marks another expansion of Mastercard’s stablecoin business following its $1.8 billion acquisition of BVNK in August. It also follows the company’s recent announcement of a Global Money Platform designed to bring stablecoin payments to businesses.

Mastercard’s stablecoin expansion comes as growth in the supply of digital dollars has slowed significantly this year, even as transaction volumes have accelerated, driven in part by remittances and cross-border payments. A recent Standard Chartered report suggests the stablecoin market could reach $2 trillion by 2030, two years later than its initial forecast.

Related: Mastercard, Borderless test shared identity checks for stablecoin transfers

Germany’s Sparkassen savings-bank group is beginning a phased cryptocurrency-trading rollout inside its existing banking app, taking an asset class it once treated cautiously into a familiar retail-finance setting.

TL;DR: The first participating Sparkassen banks are offering crypto trading from October 19. The rollout is gradual, with 30 to 40 institutions expected to join each month, and is handled through DekaBank.

There is no national switch that turns the service on for every customer at once. Each regional savings bank decides when to participate. The group’s association told German news agency dpa that the opening selection includes Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Solana and Polygon, with a substantial number of interested institutions expected to be connected during the first half of 2027.

DekaBank is providing the service with Börse Stuttgart involved in custody arrangements. Customers can access the product through the Sparkassen app instead of creating a separate account at a crypto exchange. That convenience is central to the strategy, but the banks say the product is intended for customers making their own trading decisions rather than for a mass marketing drive.

The cautious messaging is deliberate. Sparkassen continues to describe cryptocurrencies as highly speculative and warns of steep volatility and total loss. Traditional savings products remain its preferred route for broad long-term wealth building.

This is a meaningful change for the German retail market nonetheless. Banks built on deposits and household relationships are responding to demand that previously went to specialist exchanges and mobile-first financial apps. How quickly individual branches opt in will matter more than the headline customer reach of the entire network.

TL;DR: CME previously announced BCH and UNI futures for an October 19 launch, subject to regulato...

CME Group has scheduled the introduction of Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures for October 19, giving institutional derivatives traders two more cryptocurrency markets to access through a regulated venue.

TL;DR: CME previously announced BCH and UNI futures for an October 19 launch, subject to regulatory review. Standard and micro contracts are planned for both assets.

The exchange first disclosed the expansion on September 22. That timing matters: this is the scheduled start of an already announced product, not a surprise decision taken this morning. CME lists standard Bitcoin Cash contracts of 250 BCH and micro contracts of 25 BCH. For Uniswap, the respective sizes are 10,000 UNI and 1,000 UNI.

These contracts are designed to let market participants manage price exposure without arranging custody of the underlying tokens. That suits trading firms and institutions that already use futures as part of a wider portfolio or hedging operation. It also gives two assets outside the largest cryptocurrencies another route into institutional market infrastructure.

Uniswap is a particularly interesting addition because its token sits in the decentralized-finance sector. The existence of a listed futures contract does not itself establish demand for a future exchange-traded fund, nor should a derivatives launch be treated as evidence that regulators have approved any spot ETF.

CME says the planned additions respond to customer demand for risk-management tools. The exchange’s crypto product range already extends beyond Bitcoin and Ether, and the new contracts continue that approach.

The remaining detail traders should watch is the exchange’s confirmation of regulatory clearance and live trading. A published target date is not the same as confirmation that every contract has begun trading.

Zug, Switzerland, October 19th, 2026, Chainwire

StakerX’s AI Agent Surpasses Passes $40M Staked Assets on Solana Within Three Months of Launch

StakerGPT trades crypto markets around the clock and publishes every trade it makes, as more than 8,200 users join the platform

StakerX.ai, an agentic trading platform built by Switzerland-based StakerX Strategies AG, has passed $40 million in assets staked on Solana less than three months after its public launch on July 13, 2026. Users fund their stakes with more than 40 cryptocurrencies from most major blockchains, and StakerGPT, the platform’s agentic trading agent, puts that capital to work in crypto perpetual futures markets every day.

An AI agent that shows its work

An agentic system is AI software that carries out a multi-step task on its own. StakerGPT is built on rare-access Claude Mythos: it monitors crypto markets around the clock, reasons over potential trade setups, filters them through risk controls and routes the approved trades for execution, without a human placing each order.

Every trade is public. StakerX publishes the full record daily at stakerx.ai/trades, with the market, direction, entry and exit prices and return of each position, including both live-executed and signal-derived trades. As of October 18, 2026, the record holds 804 trades across 139 trading days since June 1, 2026, so anyone can check what the agent did on any given day instead of relying on summary figures.

Fund it with almost any coin

Users can deposit USDC, USDT, BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, TRX and more than 30 other cryptocurrencies from Solana, Ethereum, Bitcoin, BNB Chain, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Tron and other networks. Each deposit is converted and credited as USDC, a dollar-backed stablecoin, on Solana, so users do not need to bridge or swap anything themselves. Stakes start at $10 and run for 30 days.

Three months of growth

As of October 18, 2026, StakerX.ai reports:

  • $40 million currently staked on the platform
  • More than 8,200 registered users, of whom more than 3,000 have funded an account
  • 804 trades published across 139 trading days
  • More than 27,700 completed withdrawals, totalling $10+ million
  • Nearly $12 million in yield credited to users since launch

Coming to the App Store and Google Play

StakerX is preparing native mobile apps for iOS and Android, expected in December 2026, which will bring the dashboard, deposits and the live StakerGPT trade record to the Apple App Store and Google Play. The platform is available today on the web at stakerx.ai.

About StakerX

StakerX is an agentic trading platform built and operated by StakerX Strategies AG, a quantitative trading and investment firm based in Switzerland. Its AI trading agent, StakerGPT, is built on rare-access Claude Mythos and evaluates crypto markets, applies risk filters and routes trades, and the platform publishes every trade in its record daily. Its goal is to make agentic trading accessible to anyone who holds crypto, from any chain, with every trade on the record. StakerX launched publicly on July 13, 2026. More information is available at stakerx.ai.

title: Former Equiti Compliance Chief Charbel Raffoul Becomes GTCFX CEO
summary:

experience in compliance, financial crime and management.
London's trading industry is coming home!

content:
2026-10-19T19:31:07.800+02:00

Monday, 19/10/2026 | 17:31 GMT by Tareq Sikder

  • The new CEO previously held compliance and management roles at ATFX MENA, ADS Securities and Alpari ME.
  • The firm recently opened an office in Thailand and appointed Mei Nongbua as Country Manager.

GTCFX has appointed Charbel Raffoul as Chief Executive Officer, the company announced today. Raffoul has worked in financial services for nearly two decades, with experience in compliance, financial crime and management.

London's trading industry is coming home!

The appointment follows GTCFX's recent appointment of Abdulrahman Ahmed Al Ali as General Manager. Al Ali previously worked in the enforcement department of the UAE's Securities and Commodities Authority, now known as the Capital Market Authority.

In May 2025, GTCFX appointed Mikhail S. as Chief Commercial Officer after more than 13 years at Alpari. The broker also expanded into Thailand, where it opened an office and appointed Mei Nongbua as Country Manager to oversee local operations.

Raffoul Held Senior Roles at Equiti, ADS

Before joining GTCFX, Raffoul most recently served as Head of Compliance at ATFX MENA for one year. He previously spent almost nine years at Equiti as Chief Compliance Officer and Financial Crime Lead.

Raffoul worked at Equiti for eight years and eleven months. Before that, he served as a Director at ADS Securities for two years and three months.

Earlier in his career, he was Head of Compliance at Alpari ME for three years and ten months.

GTCFX Joins Financial Commission for Dispute Resolution

GTCFX also became a member of the Financial Commission in January 2025. The independent, non-governmental organisation provides external dispute resolution for complaints between forex and CFD brokers and their clients.

It reviews complaints and can issue decisions or award compensation under its rules. Its Compensation Fund provides up to €20,000 per eligible client claim if a member fails to comply with a compensation award. It does not cover ordinary trading losses or broker insolvency.

title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
summary: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.
content:
Revolut, a UK-based financial technology company and neobank, has received a cryptocurrency services license in Gibraltar, which it plans to use to expand its digital asset offerings into international markets beyond the UK and European Economic Area.

The Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) granted a Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) Provider license to Revolut Global Digital Assets Limited, a newly established subsidiary, according to a Monday announcement.

A Revolut spokesperson told Cointelegraph that the license will allow the company to offer crypto services in additional international markets, although specific countries and launch timelines have not been announced.

Revolut currently provides cryptocurrency services through Revolut Ltd in the UK and Revolut Digital Assets Europe Ltd across the European Economic Area, where its operations fall under the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA).

The fintech reports more than 80 million retail customers worldwide, including about 16 million cryptocurrency users, according to its announcement.

The Gibraltar license follows Revolut’s in-principle approval to offer crypto services in Dubai in July and preliminary conditional approval from US regulators in September to establish a national bank offering digital asset custody and crypto-related payment services.

Ethereum’s next major upgrade has another date on the calendar, though it is not a mainnet launch. Developers have scheduled Glamsterdam to activate on the Hoodi test network on October 26, a further step in testing changes to how Ethereum produces blocks and accounts for execution costs.

TL;DR: Glamsterdam is scheduled for Hoodi at 17:42:48 UTC on October 26. The testnet‘s gas limit will rise to 200 million at the same point, but Ethereum has not announced a mainnet activation date.

The Ethereum Foundation says the upgrade will activate at Hoodi epoch 132,352, slot 4,235,264. It follows the upgrade’s October 6 activation on Sepolia, giving developers another environment to check software compatibility before choosing a date for the main chain.

Two changes sit at the heart of Glamsterdam. Enshrined proposer-builder separation, or ePBS, moves the relationship between block proposers and builders into Ethereum’s protocol instead of relying as heavily on outside arrangements. Block-level access lists are intended to make it easier for clients to process and validate parts of a block in parallel.

The upgrade also changes gas accounting, including how Ethereum charges for state creation and access. That matters to application developers whose contracts or tools rely on fixed assumptions about gas costs. Validators and node operators on Hoodi, meanwhile, will need compatible execution and consensus clients before the activation.

A 200-million gas limit on a test network is an important engineering milestone, not a promise that mainnet capacity will instantly quadruple. The Hoodi exercise will help determine whether the planned changes behave as expected under real operating conditions. Mainnet users have no action to take yet.

title: Quant (QNT) Price Prediction: Trendline Breakout Signals Recovery as QNT Reclaims $200
summary: Quant (QNT) recovered toward $200 on Monday after falling to $182 on Sunday, as buyers stepped in following a sharp October sell-off.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: QNT

Quant (QNT) recovered toward $200 on Monday after falling to $182 on Sunday, as buyers stepped in following a sharp October sell-off.

The recovery follows a decline from approximately $242 a week earlier, leaving traders watching whether the Quant price can break through nearby resistance or resume its downward trend.

Quant Price Rebounds From $182 as Buying Returns

QNT dropped to around $182 at approximately 9 PM WAT on Sunday before climbing nearly 10% toward $200 by early Monday. The token posted a daily gain of approximately 3.7%, with 24-hour trading volume reaching $81 million. Bitcoin traded near $82,800 during the move.

The seven-day chart shows a decline from $242, followed by a sharp overnight rebound as selling pressure eased and buying demand returned. Source: @AlphaPlugCyrus via X

Despite the latest recovery, QNT remains under pressure after falling nearly 29% in October. The correction followed a September rally of more than 370%, which coincided with news of Quant’s tokenized deposit network deal with The Clearing House.

The latest price action indicates renewed demand near $182, but a sustained reversal would require further gains and stronger support at higher levels.

Quant Price Forecast: Descending Trendline Breakout Offers Hope

Crypto trader @oneandonlyseb shared two-hour Binance charts showing QNT breaking above a descending trendline as the price approached $200.31. The analyst interpreted the move as a potential signal of bullish continuation.

QNT breaks its descending trendline near $200.31, rising over 4% and signaling potential bullish continuation. Source: @oneandonlyseb via X

A descending trendline connects lower highs during a decline and can act as resistance. Breaking above it may indicate weakening selling pressure, particularly if the price holds above the line during subsequent trading sessions.

For Quant, maintaining this breakout would strengthen the short-term outlook. However, a return below the trendline could indicate that buyers lack sufficient momentum to sustain the recovery.

Community reactions remained divided, with some traders expressing interest in accumulating QNT while others questioned the analyst’s change in stance. These responses reflect uncertainty following the token’s sharp September rally and October correction.

QNT Faces $208–$224 Resistance After the Rebound

Trader AlastarTrades identified $208 as an important resistance level following QNT’s October 18 liquidation sweep near $185 and subsequent decline to $182. The analyst highlighted a sell wall and potential short liquidations above the current trading range.

Whale shorts rose from 99 to 161, with resistance at $208 and $216 and $447K in short liquidations near $224. Source: @AlastarTrades via X

A break above $208 could bring $216 into focus, which the analyst identified as the breakeven area for larger long positions. Further gains could expose approximately $224, where the analysis identified around $447,000 in potential short liquidations.

Liquidations occur when leveraged positions are forcibly closed after prices move against them. If QNT rises into these areas, short liquidations could contribute to buying pressure, although the outcome depends on market liquidity and the positions still open.

AlastarTrades also reported that whale short positions increased from 99 to 161 during the decline. A move above $208 could put some of those positions under pressure, while a drop below $188 could expose QNT to another test of its recent lows.

Bearish Structure Remains Below Key EMAs

Technical analyst @MWi_EW offered a more cautious assessment, highlighting QNT’s rejection near $213 on the eight-hour chart and its subsequent breakdown below $196 support.

The analysis identified $177 as a downside Fibonacci target associated with the 0.618 retracement level. If selling pressure continues, $150 could become a further downside reference.

QNT remains below key EMAs, with $280–$409 resistance; bullish momentum requires reclaiming $196. Source: @MWi_EW via X

Quant was also trading below key exponential moving averages (EMAs), indicating that the broader technical structure remained bearish. The analyst identified overhead resistance zones between $280 and $409.

Reclaiming $196 and holding above it would help improve the short-term outlook. Until that happens, the trendline breakout remains a tentative bullish signal rather than confirmation of a broader reversal.

Quant Partnership With The Clearing House Remains a Fundamental Catalyst

Quant’s recent market performance followed an important development in institutional payments. On September 24, 2026, The Clearing House announced that it had selected Quant to support its On-Chain Money Initiative, a planned network for clearing and settling tokenized deposits across financial institutions.

Quant will provide interoperability, orchestration, and transaction-management technology connecting tokenized deposit transactions with existing payment infrastructure, including the RTP and CHIPS networks. The initiative is expected to become available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027, according to The Clearing House announcement.

Tokenized deposits are commercial bank deposits represented and transferred through digital infrastructure. They differ from cryptocurrencies issued independently of bank deposit relationships.

The announcement coincided with increased market attention toward Quant and its role in financial infrastructure. However, the partnership alone does not establish a direct relationship between future network activity and demand for QNT. Its longer-term significance will depend on implementation, institutional adoption, and the token’s role within the ecosystem.

QNT Price Prediction: Key Levels to Watch

QNT’s near-term direction depends on whether buyers can reclaim key resistance levels while defending support.

A sustained move above $200 and a break through $208 would strengthen the recovery scenario. Further gains could bring $216 and $224 into focus, although selling pressure may emerge before either level is reached.

Quant (QNT) price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

On the downside, failure to hold $196 would weaken the bullish setup. A break below $188 could expose the recent $182 low, followed by the $177 Fibonacci level. The $150 area represents a deeper bearish scenario if selling intensifies.

For now, the trendline breakout offers a potential shift in short-term momentum, but resistance overhead and the broader bearish structure remain significant obstacles. A sustained move above $208 would provide stronger evidence of improving market conditions, while renewed weakness below $188 would increase the risk of another decline.

title: Cboe and NYSE Roll Out Pre-Market Trading for Key Stock Options
summary:
Cboe Global Markets launched extended trading hours for options on 24 stocks and five exchange-traded funds on Monday, 19 October, giving traders access before the US market opens and after its close.
London's trading industry is coming home!
The sessions on Cboe Options Exchange run from 7:30 a.m. ...
content:
2026-10-19T18:24:25.818+02:00

Monday, 19/10/2026 | 16:24 GMT by Tanya Chepkova

  • Eligible securities accounted for 53% of US-listed options volume through September.
  • NYSE American launched matching early and late options sessions on the same day.

Cboe Global Markets launched extended trading hours for options on 24 stocks and five exchange-traded funds on Monday, 19 October, giving traders access before the US market opens and after its close.

London's trading industry is coming home!

The sessions on Cboe Options Exchange run from 7:30 a.m. to 9:25 a.m. and from 4:00 p.m. to 4:15 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday to Friday.

The launch covers options on actively traded companies including Apple, Nvidia, Tesla and Amazon, alongside ETFs SPY, QQQ, IWM, GLD and XLF.

"Now, with the addition of extended trading hours for options on single stocks and ETFs, global investors will be able to manage positions and risk with more flexibility in many of the names that drive today's market," Rob Hocking, Global Head of Derivatives at Cboe, said commenting the launch.

The launch follows two postponements, with Cboe initially targeting 13 July before moving the start to 17 August and subsequently delaying it again.

More Time to Respond to Market News

Options on the eligible securities accounted for approximately 53% of average daily US-listed options volume in the first nine months of 2026, according to Cboe.

The exchange said the additional sessions would give investors more flexibility to manage positions around economic releases and corporate announcements outside regular trading hours.

Moomoo US and TradeStation Securities confirmed access for clients from launch, with other brokers offering or planning to offer the sessions.

Participation depends on how orders are designated. Orders marked for all sessions can carry over between trading periods, while those restricted to regular hours remain inactive during the additional windows.

Only limit orders are accepted in the new sessions; market, stop and stop-limit orders are excluded. The afternoon change principally extends single-stock options trading.

The eligible ETF options already trade until 4:15 p.m., with that period remaining part of their regular session. The new morning window adds pre-market access for both groups.

NYSE Launches Matching Sessions

NYSE also introduced extended hours for selected options on its NYSE American exchange on Monday. Its early and late sessions follow the same timetable as Cboe’s.

NYSE’s initial selection includes options on SPY, IWM and GLD, as well as large technology companies including Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Alphabet, Amazon and Oracle.

According to Kevin Tyrrell, chief product officer at NYSE, "extended trading hours for options reflects market demand for investment opportunities and reliable risk management during a longer period of time."

The exchange said the expansion responds to demand for a longer window to trade and manage risk. Cboe already offers near-round-the-clock weekday trading in several proprietary index options.

Its new stock and ETF options sessions have narrower hours, and the eligible list will be reviewed twice a year, with additions and removals announced in advance.

title: No ‘Uptober’ Yet: Bitcoin Slips 2% in a Month That’s Historically Bullish
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

No ‘Uptober’ Yet: Bitcoin Slips 2% in a Month That’s Historically Bullish
Bitcoin’s price is currently down so far in October — albeit slightly — as speculators last week cashed out of ETFs. Will investors change course? 
This post No ‘Uptober’ Yet: Bitcoin Slips 2% in a Month That...
content:
Bitcoin’s price retook $82,000 on Monday as choppy trading last week stunted the coin’s gains. 

The biggest cryptocurrency by market cap was recently trading for close to $82,393 — up by close to 2% over the past day but still down over a seven-day period. 

Bitcoin has gotten off to a slow start for so-called Uptober, a month when the cryptocurrency has typically surged: Since the beginning of October, bitcoin’s price has dropped by 2%. 

U.S. investors last week cashed out of exchange-traded funds, with speculators redeeming $228.4 million in shares from the investment vehicles managed by BlackRock, Fidelity, and Grayscale, according to data from Farside Investors. 

Bitcoin is often moved by investors buying shares of the U.S. ETFs. The funds give investors easy exposure to the asset via shares they can buy on their brokerage accounts. 

Despite the slow October so far, analysts have said that bitcoin is now in a bull market after spending most of 2026 trading under $70,000 — well below its all-time high of $126,080. 

Bitcoin’s price started rallying in August after the U.S. Treasury Department said it would more than double the size of its government debt repurchases. The coin had its best run in three years and third best August ever.  

The coin’s price has recently benefited from the so-called debasement trade: when investors buy certain assets to hedge against currency being devalued. The dollar slid in value in August. 

It continued to have a good September, rising nearly 6% over a 30-day period. Bitcoin in the third quarter of this year had its best three months since 2024. 

After a record third quarter, will October keep the streak alive?

Mathew Di Salvo

Mathew is a reporter who's covered the space since 2019, reporting on everything from Salvadoran president Nayib Bukele's Bitcoin bet to crypto exchange FTX's bankruptcy.

title: Strategy Keeps Buying: Third Purchase This Month Brings October Spending to $73 Million
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Strategy Keeps Buying: Third Purchase This Month Brings October Spending to $73 Million
The bitcoin treasury company notched its third buy of October last week. 
This post Strategy Keeps Buying: Third Purchase This Month Brings October Spending to $73 Million first appeared on Bitc...
content:
The largest corporate holder of bitcoin, Strategy, bought another 267 BTC last week, bringing its holdings to 848,517 digital coins — worth $69.5 billion at today’s prices. 

According to a Monday filing, the software company said it spent slightly more than $22 million on buying the new bitcoins. 

The latest buy allowed Strategy to snap up slightly more coins than its transaction the previous week, when it spent again $22 million on 250 BTC. So far in October, Strategy has spent $73 million on buying bitcoin. 

Strategy stock (NASDAQ: MSTR) was trading nearly 2% higher Monday morning New York time at about $139 per share. Over the past month, MSTR has dropped by 17%. Year-to-date, it’s down 11%. 

Monday’s filing also shows that Strategy also repurchased $193.1 million of its STRC preferred stock. 

Strategy has bought back its stock this year as its STRC preferred shares have traded below their $100 face value due to market volatility and index changes.

Strategy — formerly MicroStrategy — started buying Bitcoin in August 2020 as a way to generate better returns for its shareholders. 

It has since spent around $64 billion on BTC, making it the largest corporate holder of the asset. Investors can buy its shares to gain exposure to the leading cryptocurrency without having to buy bitcoin themselves. 

The company is now also focusing on products that pay investors yield via its STRF, STRC, STRK, and STRD preferred shares. 

Strategy could face trouble soon though after Morgan Stanley Capital International last week said it was moving ahead with a proposal “to define and classify non-operating companies as ineligible for inclusion in the MSCI Global Investable Market Indexes.” 

Such a move could eventually remove Strategy from the index, leading to fewer institutional investors holding the stock. 

Mathew Di Salvo

Mathew is a reporter who's covered the space since 2019, reporting on everything from Salvadoran president Nayib Bukele's Bitcoin bet to crypto exchange FTX's bankruptcy.

title: El Salvador’s National Bitcoin Office Hosts Five November Events Led by Herbert and Keiser
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

El Salvador’s National Bitcoin Office Hosts Five November Events Led by Herbert and Keiser
El Salvador’s National Bitcoin Office, led by Stacey Herbert and Max Keiser, has scheduled five Bitcoin-focused events from November 10–20, including Bitcoin Histórico at the National Palace ...
content:
El Salvador’s National Bitcoin Office, led by Stacy Herbert and Max Keiser of Keiser Report fame, is hosting a series of Bitcoin events this November in El Salvador. Five main events will take place, with plenty of side events hosted by the local community. 

The Bitcoin Capital Summit starts off the official schedule on November 10 at the downtown library and tech center, BINAES. Bitcoin Histórico runs November 11 and 12 at the National Palace and surrounding sites in Centro Histórico. The Renaissance Rodeo follows on November 13 at Lake Ilopango. EmTech AI LATAM is set for November 18 and 19 at the Escuela Superior de Economía y Negocios. The Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit closes the sequence on November 19 and 20 in El Zonte. 

Bitcoin Capital Summit
The Bitcoin Capital Summit takes place on November 10 from 5:00 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. at BINAES in San Salvador. Hosted by Luca Esposito of Blockstream Capital Partners in collaboration with the Bitcoin Office, the evening is framed around Bitcoin’s institutional era from treasury to capital markets. The agenda includes a welcome by Luca Esposito, a keynote by Sean Bill, former CIO of BSTR at Blockstream, and a panel on the institutional Bitcoin stack featuring Pierre Rochard, CEO of The Bitcoin Company, and Juan Diego Sol, Regional Manager, Central America at IBEX. As well as a closing fireside with Max Keiser and Stacy Herbert, among other panels. Registration is free but approval-required through the official Luma page.

Bitcoin Histórico
Bitcoin Histórico runs November 11 and 12 across the Centro Histórico of San Salvador, with keynotes at the National Palace live-streamed to giant LED screens on Plaza Gerardo Barrios. Organized by the National Bitcoin Office, the conference focuses on Bitcoin, financial freedom, and El Salvador’s transformation. Tickets are sold exclusively in Bitcoin at bitcoinhistorico.com. The $350 Trailblazer Seat includes guaranteed seating, access to public sessions, tech demos, community meetups, and an invitation to the afterparty, while locals with Salvadorian ID can buy entry with the $21 Satoshi Chero ticket. 

The $2,100 Genesis Crown Pass adds VIP seating inside the National Palace, fast-track entry, private lounge access with meals, an exclusive merch pack, and priority networking with keynote speakers. 

All tiers include free admission to the Renaissance Rodeo the following day. Promo codes CROWN15 and Cowboy21 have been shared by organizers.

Renaissance Rodeo
The inaugural Renaissance Rodeo takes place on November 13 on the shore of Lake Ilopango. The event features bull riding, mutton busting, barrel racing, music, and barbecue, and is positioned as a celebration of Salvadoran cowboy culture and regenerative agriculture. Details and a waitlist are available at the official site renaissance.rodeo. Holders of any Bitcoin Histórico ticket receive free admission.

EmTech AI LATAM
EmTech AI LATAM runs November 18 and 19 at the Escuela Superior de Economía y Negocios. This is the first Latin American edition of the MIT Technology Review conference, organized with Opinno and local partner C² Labs and supported by the Agencia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial. The agenda covers moving AI from pilots to production impact, governance, talent development, and technology trends. Coverage of the announcement is available via Diario El Salvador. Registration is available at emtechai-latam.com. 

Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit
The Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit takes place November 19 and 20 in El Zonte. Organized by Bitcoin Beach and the Federation of Bitcoin Circular Economies, this is the first public edition of the gathering. Previous events have been invite-only and have gathered top international talent, focused on delivering the benefits of Bitcoin to the developing world. 

Registration is free via the official Bitcoin Beach summit page. Confirmed speakers include Jeremy Almond, Co-Founder and CEO of Paystand, Alexandra Navarro of Paystand, Gerardo Linares, and Evelyn Lemus. The program focuses on Bitcoin as everyday money, merchant adoption, education, and lessons from circular economies across Latin America, Africa, and Asia.

The European Banking Authority has designated USDC as the EU’s first significant e-money token under MiCA, setting up an additional layer of supervision for Circle’s euro-area issuing entity.

TL;DR: The classification was announced on October 14. From November 12, the EBA takes direct responsibility for specified prudential areas of USDC supervision, while French regulators retain other oversight functions.

Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS issues the token within the bloc. The EBA said 45 e-money tokens had been notified under MiCA and that USDC was the first to cross the threshold for significant classification. It is a milestone in the operation of Europe’s crypto rulebook rather than a new stablecoin launch.

The supervisory division is more nuanced than one agency taking over everything. The EBA will assume responsibilities covering own funds, reserves, liquidity and recovery or redemption planning. France’s ACPR will continue overseeing matters including governance, outsourcing and the suitability of key personnel.

That matters because stablecoin risk is not confined to whether a dollar token tracks its peg on a quiet trading day. Redemption pressure, the liquidity of backing assets and operational failures can become important when demand for withdrawals surges. Significant-token designation puts extra scrutiny on those areas.

For European banks and payment companies evaluating USDC, a clearer line of supervision may help with due diligence. It does not remove market, custody or operational risk, and it should not be taken as a guarantee of redemption under every conceivable scenario. MiCA is meant to establish a framework for managing such risks, not make them disappear.

title: Stablecoin Payments Reach $482 Billion As Token Supply Barely Grows
summary: A new payments dataset offers a useful correction to the idea that stablecoin growth must be measured by how many tokens are in circulation. The stock of digital dollars has barely moved this year, but the amount being used for payments has climbed sharply. TL;DR: Allium estimates $482 billion in id...

Morbi pretium leo et nisl aliquam mollis. Quisque arcu lorem, ultricies quis pellentesque nec, ullamcorper eu odio.

A new payments dataset offers a useful correction to the idea that stablecoin growth must be measured by how many tokens are in circulation. The stock of digital dollars has barely moved this year, but the amount being used for payments has climbed sharply.

TL;DR: Allium estimates $482 billion in identifiable stablecoin payments through September 2026, up 45% from the comparable period. Stablecoin supply grew only 0.4% to roughly $305 billion.

The analytics firm’s October 15 research counted about 1.04 billion payment transactions across the first nine months, a 71% rise. That means the increase is not simply a handful of larger transfers distorting the total. More transactions are taking place, and the average payment has become smaller.

The figures are filtered to reflect payment activity rather than every on-chain movement. That matters when raw stablecoin transfer totals can be dominated by exchange arbitrage, transfers between a company’s own wallets or automated trading. The $482 billion estimate is not intended to represent all stablecoin transactions.

Payment companies have been connecting familiar card and banking systems to blockchain rails, reducing the need for businesses or customers to interact with crypto-specific tools. Allium’s report suggests this infrastructure is beginning to change usage patterns, even with supply essentially flat.

There are limits to what the numbers prove. Volume is not profit, nor does an active token necessarily reflect durable consumer adoption. But a market where existing coins turn over more often is different from one dependent on continuous new issuance. For payment providers, that distinction is becoming increasingly important.

title: Zerohash rolls out a new tool to move crypto without copying wallet addresses
summary: The launch comes as Zerohash bids for a federal trust charter.
content:
Oct 19, 2026, 10:58 a.m. EDT

2 min read

Summary

  • Users can approve transfers without copying wallet addresses or choosing a blockchain network.
  • Zerohash says AUTH supports more than 600 connections, with 4 of them being exchange or brokerage accounts and the rest being wallets.

Zerohash launched AUTH, a service that lets users move crypto between linked accounts without copying wallet addresses or choosing a blockchain network, simplifying digital asset transactions.

The crypto services firm announced the tool, which lets users link exchange accounts or self-custody wallets at the Money20/20 conference in Las Vegas.

“Onchain rails scale when users stop thinking about the underlying technology. Usability, trust and control is the inflection point for mass adoption,” said Ryan Beaudry, general manager of AUTH. Beaudry, who was previously executive vice president of global product and operations for open finance at Mastercard, will be the general manager of AUTH, according to a statement.

AUTH supports crypto, stablecoins and blockchain-based securities like stock tokens. Zerohash said the service supports more than 600 connections, including Coinbase, Robinhood, Gemini, MetaMask and Phantom. Zerohash’s developer documentation listed support for 639 wallets and four exchange or brokerage accounts. Coinbase, Robinhood and Gemini are live, while Kraken is in beta.

The launch comes as Zerohash seeks to expand its regulatory standing. In July, the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency returned the firm’s application for a national trust bank charter, a step the agency takes when it considers a filing materially deficient. The firm called the return an administrative process and refiled a narrower application on Aug. 18. The application is still pending.

The goal of this new product is to reduce the steps required to move funds, the firm said.

To make a transaction, users pick an account or wallet inside an app that offers AUTH, sign in and approve the move. The service handles routing and settlement, while each app sets which assets, accounts and transfer types it allows.

Alex LaPrade, CEO of a popular non-custodial Ethereum and multi-chain crypto wallet, said that transfers to wallets have previously involved repeated address checks and test payments, which were “one of the biggest points of friction” that AUTH is aiming to simplify.

Zerohash, founded in 2017, has a global regulatory footprint across the EU, Latin America, Bermuda, and the U.S., and operates regulated entities in 51 U.S. jurisdictions, according to its website. The Chicago-based company was in acquisition talks with Mastercard, which fell through earlier this year. At the time, Zerohash was reportedly in talks to raise $250 million at a $1.5 billion valuation.

Companies connect to zerohash through APIs and developer tools, and the firm handles custody, compliance, liquidity, settlement, and blockchain connectivity. The firm already provides crypto infrastructure for firms, including Morgan Stanley’s E*Trade.

title: Brokers Cut Fees to Zero for a Shot at Germany’s €240 Billion Pension Pot
summary:
Germany's online brokers have cut the cost of the country's new state-subsidized retirement depot to zero or close to it. The first contracts can start on January 1, and a survey found few savers want the version that drops the capital guarantee.
The Altersvorsorgedepot, or AVD, succeeds the Riester...
content:
Germany's online brokers have cut the cost of the country's new state-subsidized retirement depot to zero or close to it. The first contracts can start on January 1, and a survey found few savers want the version that drops the capital guarantee.

The Altersvorsorgedepot, or AVD, succeeds the Riester scheme, which held 14.7 million contracts and about €240 billion at the end of 2025, according to Börsen-Zeitung.

Only part of that money is likely to move. Forecasts for new inflows into the depot range from about €6 billion a year, based on Sirius Campus's estimate of 2.9 million contracts in the first wave, to €26 billion to €56 billion a year estimated by S&P Global, Börsen-Zeitung reported

Trade Republic has promised a fee-free account with no fund costs on several dozen ETFs, and rivals have answered with discounts of their own.

London's trading industry is coming home!

The law caps costs for the standard product at 1% a year and pays a subsidy of up to €540 a year, plus up to €300 per child. Unlike Riester, it lets subsidized money go into equity ETFs with no capital guarantee.

Consulting firm Sirius Campus puts the number of eligible people at about 44 million. That compares with 14.1 million Germans who owned shares, equity funds or ETFs in 2025, according to FM Intelligence.

Few Savers Want the Version Without a Guarantee

Maksymilian Bączkowski, senior quantitative analyst at AI Investments Ltd and a specialist in the German market and the DAX, does not expect the price war to settle the race.

"I doubt headline fees alone will decide who wins Germany's Altersvorsorgedepot," he told FinanceMagnates.com.

Sirius Campus polled 1,081 eligible people in early September. Only 11% said they were interested in a version without a capital guarantee, up from 9% in April. Of those who knew the product, 29% were willing to sign up, down from 34%.

Bączkowski noted that the survey measures stated preference rather than demand. Still, he said, it "may challenge neobrokers' low-cost, self-directed pitch."

The discounts differ mainly in how long they last. Scalable Capital charges no fund costs in the first year and up to 0.15% after that, Börsen-Zeitung reported. flatexDEGIRO covers ETF product costs for at least five years, then caps them at 0.07%, according to consumer group Stiftung Warentest.

Branch banks sit higher. Deka, the fund house of the savings banks, plans 0.1% a year, while Deutsche Bank will charge 0.10% for two years and 0.28% after that.

Christian Görgen handles growth marketing and partnerships at The Trading Pit, a prop trading firm that raised €10 million in 2022, and has worked in FX for more than 10 years. He expects the established players to gain most.

Neobrokers with a German entity are already preparing "big promotions," he wrote on LinkedIn.

"They will probably benefit most and add millions of new accounts in Q1," Görgen wrote.

Trade Republic, which turned a €34.8 million profit after securing a full banking license, has not said how long its fund-cost waiver will run.

Free Depots Built to Keep Clients Trading

Most banks say they are not chasing market share on price. In a survey of 88 institutions by securities processor dwpbank and fintech lemon.markets, 84% named customer retention as the standard depot's main value and 58% cited cross-selling. Only 28% pointed to winning new customers.

Just 7% planned to lead on price, and 51% had not yet set a pricing strategy, IT-Finanzmagazin reported. Two-thirds said customers aged 50 to 64 dominate their depot base, while families and career starters top their target lists.

Smartbroker+ shows how the depot can feed the main account. It refunds ETF fund costs in the standard depot for three years on up to €25,000 of assets, the company said on September 8. From year four, the refund requires at least 15 trades a year in the client's main Smartbroker+ account.

Bączkowski called the condition "a cross-selling incentive." For multi-asset brokers, he said, "the AVD may acquire clients, but trading still needs to generate revenue."

That trading income is changing shape as well, with Trade Republic rebuilding trade execution as the EU ban on payment for order flow takes hold.

Foreign Brokers Need More Than a Passport

Brokers from outside Germany face a separate test. Under the Retirement Provision Contracts Certification Act (AltZertG), investment firms from the European Economic Area need at least €730,000 in initial capital to act as providers.

"MiFID passporting alone does not confer AVD-provider status," Bączkowski said.

Each contract must also be certified by the Federal Central Tax Office (BZSt), which published its application form in September.

Görgen reads the law less strictly and expects the entry bar to tighten only after the launch. "The AltZertG does not seem to categorically exclude foreign multi-asset brokers," he wrote.

Trading 212 has opened a waitlist on its German site, months after it won UK approval to offer private pensions.

Trading 212 put £21.1 million into its German unit in 2025, the former FXFlat Bank now called Trading 212 EU.

XTB, whose chief executive pledged to spend more on marketing in Germany than in Poland this year, is preparing its systems for the depot. Jens Chrzanowski, branch director at XTB, told German site broker-test.de that XTB wants to offer "a cost- and tax-optimized solution."

He called the AVD "one of the most important financial reforms in decades" for German retail investors. XTB did not respond to questions sent by FinanceMagnates.com before publication.

No AVD had been certified by mid-October, according to comparison site finanzfacts.de. Deka expects its approval in November.

California has secured a $500,000 settlement with Fidelity Digital Asset Services over restrictions that previously prevented some crypto customers from moving purchased coins to their own wallets.

TL;DR: Attorney General Rob Bonta announced the settlement on October 16. California challenged historical withdrawal restrictions; Fidelity disputes that its conduct breached state law, and transfers were enabled after a 2025 regulatory approval.

The issue is a straightforward one for anyone accustomed to self-custody: buying crypto through an app is not necessarily the same as being able to withdraw it. California’s commodity rules require certain transactions to involve physical delivery within a defined period. The state’s position is that delivery of cryptocurrency requires the buyer to be able to transfer the asset away from the dealer.

Fidelity told investigators that it had been waiting for permission from the New York Department of Financial Services before allowing external withdrawals. That permission arrived in April 2025, at which point the company enabled the functionality. The state says the earlier restrictions were unlawful; Fidelity disputes that conclusion.

The California Department of Justice linked its investigation to an earlier case concerning Robinhood Crypto. The announcement is therefore part of a wider regulatory argument over what rights buyers should receive when crypto is sold through a conventional financial services interface.

The dollar amount is relatively small for a company of Fidelity’s size. The principle is larger. Regulators are examining whether customers who pay for cryptocurrencies receive meaningful control over their holdings or only an internal account balance. Investors should still check withdrawal availability and the terms of their specific account rather than assume every Fidelity product works identically.

Written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.

2026-10-19T15:55:37.835+02:00

Monday, 19/10/2026 | 13:55 GMT by Tareq Sikder

  • The Financial Commission recently added MBX PRO, RA Prime, FP Markets, OneRoyal, FXON, GTCFX and Neex.
  • VerifyMyTrade’s 5,000-order audit met execution standards, with results on IQ Option’s profile.

IQ Option has joined the Financial Commission as an approved member, giving eligible clients access to independent dispute resolution and potential compensation of up to €20,000 per client.

London's trading industry is coming home!

The addition follows several recent membership announcements. The organisation recently confirmed MBX PRO as a member. Other recent additions include RA Prime, FP Markets, OneRoyal, FXON, GTCFX and Neex.

Membership Adds Third-Party Mediation for Traders

IQ Option’s membership took effect on 30 September 2026 after the commission approved its application. It covers clients using the platform and includes access to the commission’s Compensation Fund, subject to its rules and conditions.

The Financial Commission provides third-party mediation when brokers and clients cannot resolve disputes directly. Its services cover markets including contracts for difference, forex and cryptocurrencies .

IQ Option Passes VerifyMyTrade Audit

Alongside its membership, IQ Option has completed an execution quality audit by VerifyMyTrade, an independent provider of trading execution analysis. VMT examined a sample of 5,000 order executions from IQ Option. The results met "VMT’s execution quality standards", according to the Financial Commission.

Traders can access the audit through a VMT badge on IQ Option’s member profile. The linked page shows the audit date, the number of orders analysed and whether the results met VMT’s standards.

The announcement did not disclose the detailed audit results or the sample’s size relative to IQ Option’s total order volume.

Scammers Target Traders with Fake Recovery Services

Separately, the Financial Commission has investigated an impersonation scam targeting traders with broker-related losses or blocked withdrawals. The scammers charged fees for purported fund recovery and chargeback services, using fake guarantee letters and contact details resembling those of legitimate firms and digital wallet providers.

The commission said it does not offer recovery or chargeback services, contact traders unsolicited, use messaging apps for official communication or issue guarantee letters.

title: EBC Financial Group awarded Best Broker by UF AWARDS APAC 2026
summary:
EBC Financial Group has been recognised as the winner of Best Broker by the UF AWARDS APAC 2026. The award marks a regional milestone for the London-founded international financial services group and its commitment to treating traders with professionalism and respect.
The UF AWARDS recognise the bes...
content:
2026-10-19T15:00:51.337+02:00

Monday, 19/10/2026 | 13:00 GMT by EBC Financial Group

Disclaimer

  • Regional recognition puts the focus on professional market access and trading education

EBC Financial Group has been recognised as the winner of Best Broker by the UF AWARDS APAC 2026. The award marks a regional milestone for the London-founded international financial services group and its commitment to treating traders with professionalism and respect.

The UF AWARDS recognise the best and brightest brands in online trading and fintech. The Best Broker category recognises the broker voted best in the industry across the Asia-Pacific region, with the 2026 voting round held from 25 September to 2 October.

Taking traders seriously

For EBC, the announcement provides an opportunity to highlight the standards behind its client offering: understandable information, consistent service and access to resources that help individuals make informed decisions. Its approach centres on making trading technology, liquidity, market insights and education more accessible to individual traders.

“At EBC Financial Group, we believe every serious trader deserves to be taken seriously. Receiving the Best Broker APAC award is an opportunity to thank the traders and industry participants who supported us. Our focus remains on providing clear information, professional trading resources and education that helps people understand global markets and the risks involved,” said Andria Phiniefs, Marketing Director, EBC Financial Group.

Source: EBC Financial Group, image featuring Charles Lagares (General Counsel, EBC Financial Group (UK) Limited) and Christopher Stiegeler (Chief Operating Officer, EBC Financial Group (UK) Limited) on stage, holding the ‘Best Broker - APAC’ trophy.

EBC’s belief that every serious trader deserves to be taken seriously starts with clear, verifiable information about the company. The group’s operating entities hold authorisations in the UK from the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Australia from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC), the Cayman Islands from the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority (CIMA), and South Africa from the Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA).

Professional market access

That philosophy also informs EBC’s approach to trading infrastructure. The group combines pricing from multiple liquidity sources with its own trading technology, aiming to make resources commonly associated with institutional trading more accessible to individual traders.

For larger trading instructions, EBC Private Room provides a dedicated trading channel with liquidity matching designed to preserve order confidentiality and improve aggregated quotes. EBC also emphasises clear explanations of execution, trading conditions, costs and risks, helping clients understand how the service works and make their own informed decisions.

Education and wider partnerships

Education is another part of that approach. Through market commentary and the EBC Trading Academy, the group helps traders develop their understanding of markets and risk. Its collaboration with the University of Oxford’s Department of Economics through What Economists Really Do brings research-led perspectives to economics education. EBC is also an Official Forex Partner of FC Barcelona and supports United to Beat Malaria, reflecting its wider interest in knowledge and responsible business conduct.

The award marks a milestone in EBC’s work across Asia Pacific. Its longer-term focus remains on professional service and helping traders build the knowledge to approach markets with greater understanding and risk awareness.

For more information, visit www.ebc.com

About EBC Financial Group

EBC Financial Group is a London-founded international financial services group offering access to global markets through its operating entities. Its CFD offering spans foreign exchange, precious metals, energy, indices, US shares and ETFs, with digital currency exposure limited to a Bitcoin CFD. EBC has expanded its international presence through regulated entities operating across major financial jurisdictions, including the UK, Australia, the Cayman Islands, and South Africa, among others. The Group now serves clients in over 100 countries, with more than 5 million registered users and over USD 390 billion in average monthly trading volume.
EBC firmly believes that everyone who trades seriously deserves to be treated seriously.

Products, services and applicable protections depend on the relevant entity and jurisdiction. CFDs provide exposure to price movements without ownership of the underlying assets. Trading involves the risk of losses and CFDs are not suitable for everyone.

title: India Reclaims Top Spot as US Interest Retreats in Q3 2026 Heat Map
summary:

content:
2026-10-19T15:00:00.000+02:00

Monday, 19/10/2026 | 13:00 GMT by Sylwester Majewski

  • Europe and APAC now capture 72.5% of global audience interest after North America’s market share dropped 5.9 percentage points to 14% in Q3.
  • Shifted traffic patterns outside primary centers could help brokers spot emerging client acquisition targets as audience growth spreads across Latin America, Africa, and MENA.

India is surprisingly back at the top of our Heat Map rankings, according to FM Intelligence’s Q3 data, even as its share of interest declined slightly.

Its return is one of several notable changes in the geographic distribution of attention across the FX and CFD industry this quarter. These developments could offer brokers valuable insights into where potential customers may be, while raising questions about how closely online viewership reflects customer acquisition.

Europe and APAC Still Lead

Europe accounted for 42% of global interest in Q3, up from 39.7% in Q2. The 2.3-percentage-point increase reinforced its position as the industry’s largest regional audience.

London's trading industry is coming home!

APAC also gained, lifting its share to 30.5% from 29.3%. Its recovery, however, was smaller than Europe’s advance. The gap between the two regions consequently widened to 11.5 percentage points from 10.4 points.

The largest shift occurred in North America, where the share fell to 14% from 19.9%. That 5.9-point decline left the region accounting for roughly one-seventh of global interest, compared with almost one-fifth in the previous quarter. Europe’s share was exactly three times North America’s in Q3.

Together, Europe and APAC represented 72.5% of interest, up from 69%. The regional balance therefore moved further toward the industry’s two largest audience centers, with North America losing relative weight.

RegionShare of global interest, Q2 → Q3
Europe39.7% → 42%
APAC29.3% → 30.5%
North America19.9% → 14%
Europe and APAC combined69% → 72.5%

What About Other Regions?

The redistribution extended beyond Europe and APAC. Latin America increased its share to 4.7% from 3.6%, while Africa rose to 4.7% from 3.8%. MENA advanced more moderately, reaching 4.1% from 3.7%.

Combined, these three regions accounted for 13.5% of interest, compared with 11.1% in Q2. Their gains suggest a more geographically dispersed audience outside the leading markets, although each remains substantially smaller than Europe or APAC.

North America was the only region to lose share. Its decline was matched by gains across all five other regions, making the quarter’s clearest geographic development a redistribution away from North America. The figures establish that change in audience composition, but do not identify its underlying economic or market causes.

To read the full analysis, please visit FM Intelligence portal.

Offshoring left the U.S. dependent on rivals for critical tech, says Craig Tindale. Drawing on Hamilton & Eisenhower, he frames AI as a defense mandate.

America can’t build its own defense equipment, robots, or AI hardware anymore, and Craig Tindale says that’s a national security crisis. title: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson is building a new programming language for the network
summary: Hoskinson said on X the language will bundle transaction requests with cryptographic proofs. He hasn’t shared a name, specs or a release date.
content:
Oct 19, 2026, 8:16 a.m. EDT

2 min read

Summary

  • Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson said he is personally developing a new programming language with Input Output Global engineer Lucas Rosa.
  • The language would combine transaction intents, proof-carrying data and Groth16 proofs to help applications execute user requests and efficiently verify that conditions were met.
  • Hoskinson has not disclosed the language’s name, released public code or announced when developers will be able to use it.

Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson is writing a new programming language for his blockchain. He says it will be the first to combine what a user wants a transaction to do with cryptographic proof that the rules were followed.

“I’m actually personally developing a programming language for Cardano,” Hoskinson wrote on X on Sunday, adding that he’s working on it with Lucas Rosa, a software engineer at Input Output Global who co-created Aiken, one of Cardano’s main smart contract languages.

That’s not something most founders do once their network is this big. Hoskinson runs a company full of engineers and is still choosing to write the tool future Cardano apps could be built on himself.

The language would support three tools: transaction intents, proof-carrying data and Groth16 proofs.

An intent lets a user say what they want done and leave the steps to the app. A trader could ask to swap one token for another only if the final price meets set conditions, without spelling out how to get there.

Proof-carrying data attaches cryptographic evidence to a piece of information, showing it follows certain rules. Another app can check that evidence without redoing every calculation behind it.

Groth16 is a widely used proof system that produces tiny proofs computers can check quickly. Those proofs can show a condition was met without revealing the private data used to meet it.

Together, they could let developers build apps that coordinate trades, check complicated conditions, and pass verified information between services, with Cardano checking a small proof at the end.

Cardano developers already write smart contracts in Plutus, which is built on the programming language Haskell, and in Aiken. Midnight, the privacy-focused blockchain built by Hoskinson’s company Input Output Global, has its own language, Compact, for apps that handle confidential data.

Meanwhile, Hoskinson hasn’t shared the new language’s name, any public code, or a date when developers can start using it.

title: Strategy's price chart is about to flash a major bullish signal weeks after bitcoin did
summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 19, 2026
content:
Updated Oct 19, 2026, 9:38 a.m. EDTPublished Oct 19, 2026, 7:15 a.m. EDT

3 min read

Summary

This is an excerpt from CoinDesk newsletter 'Daybook.' Sign up here, if you haven't already.

Weeks after bitcoin’s (BTC) price chart flashed a major bullish signal, Strategy MSTR$135.98·Market Closed, the largest publicly listed accumulator of the cryptocurrency, is about to do the same.

The signal, a golden cross, occurs when a security’s 50-day average price rises above its 200-day average. Some traders read the transition as a decisive bullish shift in momentum that can lead to a prolonged rally.

For MSTR, which holds $69.81 billion in bitcoin, the cross could happen as soon as Monday. Since the company began buying the largest cryptocurrency for its balance sheet in August 2020, the stock has had two such crosses, and huge rallies followed both.

The first happened on Sept. 15, 2020, with the stock at about $15.57. MSTR climbed to $127.29 by February 2021, a gain of 717%. A death cross, the opposite of golden cross, followed in January 2022. By then, the stock was at $46.83, still triple the value on the day the bullish signal first appeared.

The second came on March 2, 2023, at $25.29. The shares peaked at $473.83 in November 2024, up 1,774%. When the death cross arrived in October 2025, MSTR was at $328.40, still 1,199% higher.

It’s worth keeping in mind that the signal isn’t especially reliable. In MSTR’s case, since 1999, the shares have registered 19 golden crosses. On 11 occasions, the stock was higher three months later, and after only 10 was it higher 12 months later, according to data analyzed by CoinDesk.

That’s a record of 50% accuracy. The median 12-month return was just 3.3%, and the two worst crosses, in 2001 and 2007, were followed by a 61% loss.

Since bitcoin confirmed its golden cross on Sept. 8, it has risen by nearly 5% to $82,000, extending the rally from July lows under $60,000. The price hit a high of over $87,000 early this month.

It remains to be seen if MSTR follows bitcoin’s lead. Stay alert!

Nasdaq also rejected tokenization of its own stock under the framework, citing concerns about pricing transparency and trade reporting.
